result.note: Tested the venue of the BRICS Communications Ministers' meeting where India and Brazil signed a telecom MoU; the Mexico PTA signing is only expected.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, India signed a telecom and technology Memorandum of Understanding with Brazil, covering artificial intelligence, 5G and 6G, and cybersecurity, at the BRICS Communications Ministers' meeting held in which Indian city?
questions.explain: Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia signed the MoU with Brazil at the BRICS Communications Ministers' meeting in Pune. Separately, India and Mexico finalised the Terms of Reference for a preferential trade agreement after Mexico imposed tariffs of up to 50 per cent on goods from non-preferential partners.
questions.source: signed a telecom and technology Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Brazil, covering artificial intelligence, 5G and 6G, and cybersecurity, at the BRICS Communications Ministers' meeting in Pune.
